description:
Handoff record for the successor session. Read with the opum-handoff skill; the tracker and git outrank this note. Filed only, nothing to implement here: close it when the successor has read it.

No open PRs of mine, no In Progress tasks (read: quest task list --status "In Progress" returned 0), clean tree on dev. STALE LOCAL BRANCHES REMAIN (predecessors', NOT verified as landed and NOT deleted): chore/QCLI-497-605-land, chore/QCLI-497-606-land, chore/QCLI-497-complete, chore/QCLI-499-finalize-0.14.1-changelog, chore/QCLI-499-record-opumdoc-review, chore/QCLI-499-renewal-handoff, chore/QCLI-516-verdict-record, fix/QCLI-516-hand-cut-hint, qcli-432-complete-and-file-followups, qcli-461-complete, qcli-file-uac-defect, release/0.13.1-prep, plus local main. Deleting is a lifecycle step, but check each for no worktree and for files matching dev (a squash-landed branch shows unmerged by ancestry), then git branch -D bare, one per call; release/0.13.1-prep and qcli-file-uac-defect look like they may carry unlanded work, so read them before any delete.

DONE THIS SESSION: QCLI-495 (worktree-aware, ledger-backed id allocation, DEC-179 part 1) landed in #646 after three review rounds, closed via #649, promoted via #650. QCLI-512 (QCLI-509 record corrections) via #651, promoted via #652. QCLI-515 closed via #653 (dev only). QCLI-521 (previous handoff) closed via #648.

QCLI-515 AC4 IS UNRESOLVED ON PURPOSE: it asks that the PR carry the 0.14.1 promote dry run and that a release record say the flag was used once. #634 does not carry them and no release record says it. The evidence that the flag WAS used lives on QCLI-499 (dry run, then the --promote run with --notes-from ce33f6d50cd193d2673ceede40fc4e89d5549c99; v0.14.1 published 2026-10-20T17:50:26Z). The leader ruled: do NOT amend AC4; completing with it unchecked is the honest state.

NOTHING IS WAITING ON A PLAN WORD, and nothing has been started or approved among these (all unstarted, To Do): QCLI-519 (quest task view --ref, DEC-206 c3, rides the next lore/quest pair), QCLI-520 (Backlog migration mints ids outside the allocator), QCLI-522 (allocation-lock timeout hint must report alloc.lock.break), QCLI-523 (break-file release test must pin the stamp half). Do not start any without the leader word. No release actions ever: tier 3, operator first-party.

TRAPS (measured this session): 1. A startup tracker block's In Progress list is OPEN WORK: I answered two nonce checks with "no open task" while QCLI-515 sat In Progress in that block; read the block and run quest task list --status "In Progress" before reporting state. 2. Format with biome, not prettier: bunx biome format --write <files>; bun run format:check is the gate (prettier reflowed main.ts and CHANGELOG.md and failed source-gates on #646). 3. zsh does not split an unquoted flag variable: run quest writes with the actor flags written out, never in a shell variable. 4. BSD sed on macOS rejects GNU one-liners; a failed sed chained with ; before git add committed conflict markers once. Use python for edits and check markers before committing. 5. Run ONE full suite at a time: two at once caused 60s timeouts. Local bun 1.3.14 vs repo pin 1.4.2 means exactly one expected failure, the QCLI-411 check. 6. A review verdict is recorded verbatim on the task naming unit, model, head and worktree; keep every review-<pr>-<sha7> worktree (DEC-208). 7. Run git push and gh pr merge bare in their own call; branch in its own call before committing; gh pr merge --delete-branch also deletes the local branch. 8. Promotion: open the dev-to-main PR so the unfiltered pull_request trigger supplies all three required contexts on a tracker-only tip, wait for them on that exact SHA, then git push origin origin/dev:main and read the API ref plus rev-list --count origin/main..origin/dev (must be 0). promotion-is-manual failing is by design. 9. A completed record is corrected by demote then complete in quest, which is also the only way unresolvedAtCompletion is persisted. Skills: opum-handoff, opum-sdlc, opum-tool-output.
